title: Hedging currency cards sort by policy-gap severity in GBP
context: Cards were alphabetical (CHF, EUR, USD). The treasurer's eye should land on the biggest actionable risk first — that means biggest gap to the hedge policy, expressed in a currency-neutral unit for cross-comparison.
decision: FxExposureService.summary() sorts by _gap_gbp_pence descending, then by gross_gbp_pence as a tie-break. Full-coverage currencies sink to the bottom. The AI briefing ranks in the same order.
alternatives_rejected: Alphabetical (default behaviour — no signal in the order)
By gross GBP exposure (biggest total, but ignores how much of it is unresolved)
By native-currency gap (USD $21m > EUR €20m — but that ranking flips at rates, misleading a UK treasurer)
consequences: Each card renders a rank badge '#N · Biggest gap / 2nd priority / 3rd priority'
A one-line label above the cards explains the sort
The AI briefing paragraph names the biggest gap first for consistency
